meaning:
πικρῶς
adv. (πικρός), [in LXX for מַר, מָרַר pi. ;]
bitterly: metaphorically, (cf. πικρὸν δάκρυον, Hom.), ἔκλαυσε π., Mat.26:75, Luk.22:62 (see MM, xviii, see word παρακολουθέω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.
He went out, and wept bitterly.
